text: {"label":"Tact Training in Autism","definition":"Research on teaching children with autism to label stimuli (tacts), comparing procedures, reinforcement delays, stimulus set sizes and background stimuli, and examining generalization and emergent intraverbal-tact and listener responding.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on tact acquisition, unlike neighbours on divergent intraverbals and vocalization, sign language and communication for deaf or blind learners, or general skill-acquisition procedures in autism."}
